purpose: Transparent annual model for three guest-house suites; not an accountant, payroll, tax or legal forecast

glossary.property_company: Société civile immobilière CSL, owner of the château
glossary.operating_company: Future commercial company operating the guest house
glossary.shareholder_current_account: Interest-free associate advance recorded as a debt of the receiving entity
glossary.average_public_nightly_price: Average public tax-inclusive price for one suite and one night

signature_table.commercial_rule: One menu, advance booking, one fixed service time and deliberately limited service days.

tax.warning: Rates, mixed supplies, deduction rights and invoicing require professional validation.

staffing.warning: Annual capacity does not replace a weekly roster respecting rests, leave and simultaneous services.

property_rent.reference_rule: The rent must be supported by market value and the lease. An 18,000 EUR rent makes the operating company cash-negative in the five-year repayment case even though consolidated cash is unchanged.

investment_and_shareholder_current_accou.allocation_rule: Preserve the earlier 35,000 EUR SCI / 15,000 EUR operating-company split and provisionally allocate the additional 30,000 EUR Maisonnette works to the SCI. Final allocation follows itemized invoices and asset ownership.
investment_and_shareholder_current_accou.repayment_rule: Repay principal only after each entity's closing and rolling cash review. Missing an annual target leaves interest-free principal outstanding and requires an explicit later catch-up; no automatic transfer between entities is assumed.
investment_and_shareholder_current_accou.alternative_allocation_test: A 60,000 EUR SCI / 20,000 EUR operating-company allocation aligns the SCI's 12,000 EUR annual target with rent, but it requires at least 5,000 EUR of legitimate operating-company assets or initial operating cash.

methodological_two_suite_counterfactual.control_rule: Keep price, offer, VAT treatment and staffing prudence identical; change only suite count and the cost and funding inputs directly linked to the Maisonnette.

calculation_rules.operating_result_before_rent: accounting_revenue - variable_costs - fixed_operating_costs - Jules employer budget - paid support
calculation_rules.property_company_cash_before_existing_co: property rent received - SCI shareholder-current-account principal repayment

decision_gates: Confirm the Maisonnette adds one guest-house room only and keeps the total within five rooms and fifteen guests.
Itemize the 80,000 EUR envelope and identify the owner and payer of every asset.
Approve separate interest-free shareholder-current-account agreements for the SCI and operating company.
Confirm that every contributor is eligible to hold a shareholder current account in the receiving entity.
Record each associate's contribution and outstanding principal in a restricted schedule.
Do not make a repayment that leaves either entity cash-negative.
Obtain payroll validation for Jules and quotes for 1,175 paid-support hours.
Validate VAT, rent, lease, room count, insurance and works treatment with the relevant professionals.
Create a named weekly roster for Jules, paid support and no more than 200 associate hours.
